summary: Pass 28 closes the native first/family-name storage widths and corrects the Classic law contract without inventing unresolved Fiend, guard cadence, bounty, arrest, jail, or trap behavior.

facts.claim: The native MajorMUD user record stores FirstName as 10 bytes and LastName as 18 bytes.
evidence: Nightmare Redux modFieldmaps_vO.bas UserRecType: FirstName As String * 10; LastName As String * 18
Nightmare Redux AddUserFieldMap: FLD_STRING 10 for firstname and FLD_STRING 18 for lastname
Librarium/Evidence/native_message_catalog_correlation_0022.json catalog 3 EDTCHAN2: Given Name has 10 question-mark cells and Family Name has 18
facts.boundary: EDITCHA1 visually allocates an 18-character screen slot for Given Name. Pass 28 does not misread that presentation width as native storage capacity; the 10-byte UserRec field is authoritative for persisted first-name length. Minimum length and allowed-character grammar remain unresolved native semantics.

facts.claim: Attacking a Lawful player applies three times the otherwise-applicable evil-point attack penalty.
evidence: Librarium/Evidence/native_message_catalog_correlation_0022.json HL1B11: Attacking a lawful player will give thrice the evil points
Librarium/Evidence/native_message_catalog_correlation_0022.json GOODTEXT: attacks/robbery against Lawful receive three times the regular evil points
runtime: Apps/Compiler/src/LibrariumDataWriter.cs projects only the executable multiplier

facts.claim: Native help defines Outlaw as guards attacking on sight but sparing life; Criminal as the same except guards slay; Villain as Criminal plus possible intervention by the Gods. The prior Reforged bounty-hunter escalation was speculative and is removed from the Classic authority.
facts.boundary: Fiend help only states that it is the utmost evil and survival is unlikely. Exact Fiend-specific guard/divine behavior is still UNKNOWN. The separately proven 300+ EP attack-initiation lockout remains active.

facts.claim: Native GOODTEXT/GOODPMPT and ENABLAWF prove an optional Lawful character choice, permanent until a new character, blocking initiation of actions that give evil points while still permitting attacks on bad-reputation targets.
facts.boundary: Pass 28 does not activate the creation choice because exact reputation cutoff/action classification and creation sequencing are not sufficiently recovered for a fail-safe implementation.

facts.claim: Native help exposes FORGIVE <user> to counter evil points gained from an accidental attack, with an approximately five-minute window; setup defaults include MAXEPDAY=18, EPCYCLE=60 and EPAMOUNT=1.
facts.boundary: The approximate timing and exact accounting/history state are insufficient for exact runtime activation in this pass.

facts.claim: Pass 28 rechecked the retained/public native room sources. They confirm trap field/state structure but still do not recover stock WCCMP002 per-exit Para2 values, SEARCH probability, DISARM roll, failed-disarm trigger or exact state transition/reset ordering.
facts.boundary: No speculative trap behavior is added. Pass 27 trap UNKNOWNs remain intact.
